name: @cocreate/api
description: A secure, multi-tenant API execution gateway and proxy layer that dynamically resolves endpoint actions, processes AST micro-operators, handles webhooks, and manages third-party integrations with strict tenant environment isolation.
author: CoCreate LLC

attributes.name: api | module
attributes.role: Declares/registers an API provider name; provider-specific attributes are derived from this name.

attributes.name: {name}-endpoint
attributes.role: Endpoint name or path; may be defined on an ancestor group.

attributes.name: {name}-key
attributes.role: Maps an element's value into request data or maps response data back to the element. A key ending in [] accumulates values into an array; {} maps the whole object.

attributes.name: {name}-event
attributes.role: Limits automatic requests to matching event types.

attributes.name: {name}-request | {name}-response
attributes.role: Excludes an element from request collection or response mapping when set to false.

actions.name: {name}
actions.description: Actions integration registers each provider as an action; invocation requests the provider operation and processes its response.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Scans declarative providers when called without a config, or registers the supplied provider config.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a provider, its Actions callback, DOM listeners, and observers.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Builds and dispatches a provider request from context and associated elements.

methods.name: response
methods.description: Handles a response, maps values to elements, dispatches completion, and routes errors.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a client request through CoCreate Socket.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Collects and normalizes request values from the relevant element group.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Maps response data back to matching elements using setValue or renderValue.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Binds server services and returns the server API object.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Resolves API and endpoint configuration, evaluates configured AST operations, or sends an outbound HTTP request.

methods.name: webhook
methods.description: Resolves and processes an incoming configured webhook request.

methods.name: makeHttpRequest
methods.description: Dispatches a fetch request with timeout and response/error handling.

methods.name: getApiConfig
methods.description: Resolves an enabled provider configuration for an organization and host.
